name: Caval

attributes.attribute: Tennyson's spelling of the name Cabal

text: Caval is a spelling that the poet Tennyson used for Cabal. Cabal is King Arthur's hound. Other spellings of the name include Cafall and Cavall. Tennyson carried the beast into his Arthurian verse. Readers who meet Caval in that poetry can trace the dog back to the older tradition.

okr.objective: Point readers from this poetic variant to the hound Cabal.
key_results: MacKillop records Caval as a spelling used by Tennyson.
Cabal serves as the hound of Arthur.
The name also surfaces as Cafall and Cavall.
